messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a concise list of the long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Monday or Friday, giving you a three‑day break (Saturday‑Sunday‑holiday or holiday‑Saturday‑Sunday).

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, etc.) | Monday | Feb 18–20 |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | Apr 7–9 |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | May 20–22 |
| **Jul 1** | Canada Day (observed on Jul 3 because Jul 1 was a Saturday) | Saturday | Jul 1–3 |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | Sep 2–4 |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | Oct 7–9 |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day (observed on Nov 13 because Nov 11 was a Saturday) | Saturday | Nov 11–13 |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | Dec 23–25 |

**Notes**

- **Family Day** is observed in several provinces; if you’re in a province that doesn’t observe it, you’ll have a different long weekend that year.
- **Canada Day** fell on a Saturday in 2023, so the statutory holiday was observed on Monday, July 3, creating a three‑day weekend.
- **Remembrance Day** fell on a Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday, November 13, giving you a long weekend from November 11–13.
- **Christmas Day** fell on a Monday, giving you a long weekend from December 23–25.

Feel free to integrate this table into your holiday‑planning app!
